question: top 3 queens pickup zones by trip count
sql: WITH cnt AS (SELECT z.zone, z.borough, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON t.PULocationID = z.location_id WHERE z.borough = 'Queens' GROUP BY z.zone, z.borough) SELECT zone, borough, trips, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY trips DESC, zone) AS rn FROM cnt ORDER BY trips DESC, zone LIMIT 3;

question: borough total fare running sum
sql: WITH b AS (SELECT z.borough, SUM(t.total_amount) AS total_fare FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON t.PULocationID = z.location_id GROUP BY z.borough) SELECT borough, ROUND(total_fare, 2) AS total_fare, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_fare DESC, borough) AS rnk, ROUND(SUM(total_fare) OVER (ORDER BY total_fare DESC, borough ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING), 2) AS running_total FROM b ORDER BY total_fare DESC, borough;

question: longest trip per borough
sql: WITH r AS (SELECT z.borough, t.trip_distance, t.tpep_pickup_datetime, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY z.borough ORDER BY t.trip_distance DESC, t.tpep_pickup_datetime DESC, t.PULocationID, t.DOLocationID) AS rn FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON t.PULocationID = z.location_id) SELECT borough, trip_distance, tpep_pickup_datetime FROM r WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY trip_distance DESC, borough;

question: top 2 zones per borough by average tip
sql: WITH a AS (SELECT z.borough, z.zone, AVG(t.tip_amount) AS avg_tip, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON t.PULocationID = z.location_id GROUP BY z.borough, z.zone HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20), r AS (SELECT borough, zone, avg_tip, trips, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY borough ORDER BY avg_tip DESC, zone) AS rnk FROM a) SELECT borough, zone, ROUND(avg_tip, 2) AS avg_tip, trips, rnk FROM r WHERE rnk <= 2 ORDER BY borough, rnk, zone;

question: top 5 pickup zones with centroid coords
sql: WITH cnt AS (SELECT z.location_id, z.zone, z.borough, COUNT(*) AS pickups FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON t.PULocationID = z.location_id GROUP BY z.location_id, z.zone, z.borough) SELECT c.zone, c.borough, c.pickups, ROUND(ST_X(ST_Centroid(z.geometry)), 5) AS lon, ROUND(ST_Y(ST_Centroid(z.geometry)), 5) AS lat, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.pickups DESC, c.zone) AS rnk FROM cnt c JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON z.location_id = c.location_id ORDER BY c.pickups DESC, c.zone LIMIT 5;

question: zones within 3km of -73.9857, 40.7484 ranked by pickups
sql: WITH near AS (SELECT location_id, zone, borough, ST_Distance_Sphere(ST_Centroid(geometry), ST_Point(-73.9857, 40.7484)) AS dist_m FROM nyc_taxi_zones WHERE ST_Distance_Sphere(ST_Centroid(geometry), ST_Point(-73.9857, 40.7484)) <= 3000) SELECT n.zone, n.borough, COUNT(t.*) AS pickups, ROUND(n.dist_m) AS dist_m, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(t.*) DESC, n.zone) AS rn FROM near n LEFT JOIN nyc_taxi_trips t ON t.PULocationID = n.location_id GROUP BY n.zone, n.borough, n.dist_m ORDER BY pickups DESC, n.zone LIMIT 5;
